resources.string: Displays this week\'s Shabbat candle lighting and Havdalah times for your location.

This app provides a home screen widget showing this week\'s Shabbat candle lighting and Havdalah times based on your current location.\n\nAdd the widget to your home screen by long-pressing an empty area on your home screen and selecting Widgets.

To add the widget:
1. Long-press an empty spot on your home screen
2. Tap "Widgets"
3. Find "Shabbat Times" and drag it to your home screen
